name: capto
description: Find and assess government contracting opportunities. Search contracts, grants, forecasts, awards and SBIR/STTR topics; review opportunity fit and agency context; and save relevant opportunities to a pursuit pipeline.

interface.longDescription: Capto helps government contractors and business development teams find and assess relevant government contracting opportunities. Search contracts, grants, forecasts, awards and SBIR/STTR topics; retrieve opportunity details and official sources; assess fit; research government buying agencies; and save suitable opportunities to a pursuit pipeline. Capto supports research and decision-making; users remain responsible for eligibility checks and bid decisions.
defaultPrompt: Find government contract opportunities that match my company.
Which opportunities in my Capto feed are the best fit for us, and why?
What is the Department of Homeland Security buying, and who are its incumbents?

review.commerce_description: Capto does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

positive.description: Search the opportunity feed for a relevant federal contracting opportunity. Use a company context already available to the connected Capto account.
positive.prompt: Find recent federal contract opportunities related to cybersecurity.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_opportunities with query terms related to cybersecurity and opportunity kinds where appropriate. Present returned opportunity titles, agencies, deadlines, and fit scores only when present in the tool response. Do not invent results or scores.

positive.description: Find a relevant opportunity and retrieve its full details and fit assessment.
positive.prompt: Search Capto for cybersecurity opportunities and give me the full details and fit assessment for the best match.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_opportunities, then call get_opportunity with the exact id of the chosen result. Summarize the returned description, agency, deadline, set-aside, fit assessment and next step where available. Do not invent fields the tool did not return.

positive.description: Find a relevant opportunity and retrieve its official sources.
positive.prompt: Find a cybersecurity opportunity in Capto and show me its official notice and source documents.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_opportunities, then call get_sources with the exact id of the chosen result. List the official notice and document links from the returned data. Do not fabricate source links.

positive.prompt: Prepare an agency brief for the Department of Homeland Security, including its buying patterns.
positive.expected_behavior: Call get_agency_brief with agency_name set to Department of Homeland Security. Summarize the returned mission, budget, buying patterns, incumbents, contacts, freshness and citations when available.

positive.description: Find a relevant opportunity and save it to the company's pursuits at the user's explicit request.
positive.prompt: Find an open cybersecurity contract opportunity in Capto that fits us and save it to our pursuits.
positive.expected_behavior: Call search_opportunities with kinds limited to opportunity, then call save_opportunity with the exact id of the chosen result. Report the returned pursuit name and link, or that it was already saved. Do not claim it was saved if the tool fails.

negative.description: The user asks Capto to submit a government bid. Bid submission is outside the available Capto tools.
negative.prompt: Submit a completed bid proposal to the contracting officer for me.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Capto tool to submit a bid. Explain that Capto can help research and assess opportunities but cannot submit proposals.

negative.description: The user asks Capto to purchase a contract or pay an agency.
negative.prompt: Buy this government contract for my company and pay the agency fee.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Capto tool. Explain that Capto does not purchase contracts or make payments on the user's behalf.

negative.description: The user asks Capto to guarantee award success or make an official eligibility determination.
negative.prompt: Guarantee that we are eligible and that we will win this contract.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not call any Capto tool to claim a guarantee. Explain that Capto provides research and fit assessments, not official eligibility determinations or guarantees of award.

publication.release_notes: Initial public-submission package for Capto with opportunity search, assessment, agency research and pursuit-saving workflows.
